items.summary: In the Drug Interaction Checker results (Drug-Drug tab), explicitly display the interacting drug pair (e.g., "Warfarin + Aspirin") for each pairwise interaction result so users can clearly see which two drugs the interaction report refers to. This drug-pair label must be shown for both cases: (1) when interaction details are available, and (2) when no interaction data is found for that pair (the label should still be shown alongside the no-data message).
